sections.heading: BookYourData ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if lead management + contact management are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if No native email sequencing or multichannel engagement — outreach has to run in a separate tool collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: lead management; contact management; reporting; lead scoring.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Credit packs, BeSpoke.

sections.heading: Who BookYourData is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Teams whose bottleneck is verified contact coverage rather than outreach workflow — especially outbound and recruiting buyers who prefer to pay per record, test a new ICP cheaply, and keep sequencing in a tool they already own..

Avoid if: Buyers who want prospecting and sequencing under one subscription should compare Apollo or Reply; teams that need continuous CRM enrichment and buying signals should look at Lusha; and shoppers who need published per-record price cards before evaluating should check RocketReach..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Apollo.io on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: BookYourData price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Usage-based credit flexibility vs the budget predictability of a seat subscription.

Next step: run lead management end-to-end, then decide.
